position_sizing.conditional_logic: After a losing deal, lot size doubles (kLot*=2) and take profit is overridden to comLoss (cumulative loss recovery amount); after a winning deal, lot and compensation reset to baseline

custom_logic_notes: Weekly periodic range breakout: On a specified day-of-week at a specified hour+1, the EA captures the previous H1 bar close as center price and computes a breakout channel (center +/- Range). Range is derived from prior day's ATR value scaled by perATR%. If price breaks above pHighStop, a buy is placed; if below pLowStop, a sell is placed. SL and TP are set as fixed offsets from the breakout level. Martingale recovery: after a loss, lots double and TP is set to comLoss (the amount needed to recover cumulative losses), while SL is widened by comLoss. On a win, martingale resets. The EA uses a 3-phase state machine (STANDBY→SETUP→TRADE) and only trades one position at a time per weekly cycle.
python_conversion_notes: The martingale loss compensation formula (comLoss = cumLoss * _Point * 10 / (kLot * tick_value)) is broker/symbol-specific and requires SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE which varies. The ATR fallback to price percentage when buffer copy fails adds conditional logic. The weekly periodic trigger (day_of_week + hour check on tick) and phase state machine must be faithfully replicated. Position tracking via ticket requires position monitoring. The intrabar breakout detection needs tick-level data for accurate backtesting.
